text:
Chip Fields played Rochelle, one of J.J.'s girlfriends, in "J.J.'s New Career, Part 2" (Season 4, Episode 8). This matches [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chip_Fields), [TVmaze](https://www.tvmaze.com/characters/204646/good-times-rochelle), and [TheTVDB](https://thetvdb.com/series/good-times/episodes/238770), though I only saw search snippets from these, not the full pages. The team note's "Thelma" credit doesn't match any of these sources, so I'd treat it as wrong unless someone can point to a cast list that shows it.

CONFIDENCE: 85
